# Quantized commit (MIDI-clock ready)

With Q on, intents are scheduled to the next beat (or bar) and stamped with their grid delta — @b12+0.3ms. The clock is an internal metronome or external MIDI clock (24 PPQN, median-filtered tempo, phase per beat). Budget: grid jitter p95 ≤ 1 ms.
